title: Marquesan language - Wikipedia
text: Marquesan is a collection of East-Central Polynesian dialects, of the Marquesic group, spoken in the Marquesas Islands of French Polynesia. They are usually classified into two groups, North Marquesan and South Marquesan, roughly along geographic lines. [2]

title: Marquesas Songs: Music and Chant of the Islands
text: What is traditional Marquesan music like? Older music centres on the pee, rhythmic chants carried by deep pahu drums, powerful and earthy rather than sweet, matching the steep, dramatic islands. What is the bird dance of the Marquesas? The haka manu of Ua Pou, in which performers spread their arms and step to the drums in imitation of seabirds.
